record.title: Expose sealed offline review through a delegated redacted CLI
record.intent: Make the independent libraries useful together without coupling them to a bench runner.
requirements: Add a Click endpoint calling a typed delegate and reusable review library with explicit root manifest expected digest and role configuration arguments.
Render a bounded TOML result with input hashes and stage-specific failures; hide all identity strings and private endpoint paths by default.
Compare the preserved identity run without modifying its original files and demonstrate installed-wheel consumption outside the checkout.
Document role assertions and unresolved origin lifecycle and timing claims separately from verified byte consistency.
acceptance: Preserved comparison and independent CLI packaging controls pass without physical contact.
